title: Lane bootstrap should resolve the Yeroket kernel checkout for paired worktrees
body: The GB1 brief named a kernel .claude-worktrees/gb1k without naming the kernel repository. The first worktree creation targeted the Undertow facade checkout; recovery required removing it and recreating the lane under /home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy. Existing VIXEN codegen root probing also assumes a different sibling layout. Make the workspace/launcher contract identify the Yeroket-Fantasy kernel root and validate the selected repository before creating or pairing a lane worktree. Tier luna: this crosses lane provisioning and VIXEN provider discovery. Exact recovery: git worktree add -b lane-gb1k /home/liory/projects/Yeroket-Fantasy/.claude-worktrees/gb1k lane-d11row.

title: GPU storage-buffer scheduling needs a generated resource identity
body: The supplied 8e5 GPU generator emitted wildcard storage-buffer accesses for the scatter-to-sort pass, so the scheduler rejected the generated producer/consumer pair. The lane had to patch the kernel generator to emit a stable GPU-buffer resource identity before the declared pass could schedule; the facade should derive this identity automatically.

title: VIXEN codegen refresh requires worktree-root invocation
body: A queued refresh from the VIXEN subdirectory failed because build-wsl.sh is rooted at the worktree; the documented route requires manually changing to the repository root. The facade should expose one deterministic consumer-root entrypoint.

title: Tile schema regeneration must precede frame-target SDI regeneration
body: The first root codegen refresh scheduled frame-target SDI before TileSortedCandidate.glsl existed, so the lane had to add an explicit CMake dependency from frame_targets_sdi_regen/refresh to tile_binning_structs_regen. The facade should derive this dependency closure.

title: Kernel pin refresh must regenerate the recipe opcode mirror with the recipe dispatch
body: After switching the VIXEN consumer to the d11 generated dispatch, the tracked SdfOpCodes.g.h remained d10 until the separate recipe_opcode_mirror_regen target was run. The facade should make the opcode mirror part of the same pin-driven recipe generation contract.

title: VIXEN build wrapper can terminate with SIGPIPE after successful codegen
body: Queued build-wsl.sh stopped with SIGPIPE after codegen completion and before target compilation, without a payload diagnostic; direct queued cmake --build build/wsl --target VixenApp was required to recover. The wrapper should preserve the target process and report its real status.

title: D11 recipe dispatch requires a refreshed VoxelDocument generated header
body: The d11 generated RecipeSimd dispatch references defaultMaterialReference, but VIXEN still carried the reverted d10 VoxelDocument.g.h. Recovery required running the kernel VoxelDocumentEmitterTests refresh with UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 and transferring the generated header before the full test target could compile. The consumer pin contract should refresh all coupled recipe artifacts together.

title: Native witness wrapper requires a committed lane tip
body: The documented native wrapper synchronizes only the committed branch tip; starting it with a dirty worktree emitted a warning and would have built the old commit. The witness flow should either reject dirty source before queue admission or provide an explicit immutable snapshot route.

title: Full Vixen CTest registry contains stale NOT_BUILT entries
body: The full queued CTest invocation was terminated while traversing the registry at sdi_merged_drift_check, and the narrowed filter initially reported dozens of NOT_BUILT registrations unrelated to the built target. The CMake test registry should not register unavailable placeholders in a consumer build, or should expose a target-scoped suite.

title: Generated GPU dispatch guards must precede storage-buffer loads
body: The GB1 generated GPU systems accepted a managed first-statement tail guard but emitted storage-buffer arguments before calling the body, so frame-sized dispatches read past per-instance/per-tile buffers and caused VK_ERROR_DEVICE_LOST. The generator should derive and hoist canonical dispatch guards before argument loads.

title: GPU legacy fixtures need a declared GB1 stream contract
body: GB1 replaces the primary camera skip-mask path with generated per-tile candidates, but standalone GPU fixtures still own the legacy full-instance descriptor layout. Recovery required a test-only shader switch in BodyInstanceRayMarch.comp, five manual glslc defines in test_critical_nodes.cmake, and source injection in test_baked_vs_virtual_parity.cpp. The facade should generate a fixture-compatible resource bundle or derive descriptor bindings from the selected production/legacy contract; the retired B1 camera-mask assertion must be explicitly migrated rather than left as an unclassified GPU red.

title: Bench queue owner marker must survive admission retries
body: Every native capture wrapper repeatedly emitted /tmp/undertow-box-bench/state.lock.d/owner: No such file or directory while waiting for admission, and the queue continued with refusal estimates instead of a stable owner marker. The witness flow had no in-scope repair and had to keep the queued jobs alive. The box queue should create or recover its bench owner marker atomically before admission polling and surface a bounded retry state.

title: Native GPU fixture target names should be discoverable
body: The queued rebuild command using target test_b1_occlusion failed with an unknown-target error; CMake defines test_b1_occlusion_ab. Recovery required inspecting test_critical_nodes.cmake and resubmitting the corrected target. The facade should expose generated/validated target names or a target-list helper so queued witness commands do not spend a GPU/build reservation on a typo.

title: GPU dispatch guard lowering must preserve singleton buffer blocks
body: Native runtime compilation of the generated TileBinScatterSystem and TileBinSortSystem failed with view.instanceCount/view.tilesX because the hoisted guard reused the body visitor's lowered singleton value spelling instead of the reflected storage-buffer block. Recovery required kernel commit a001ab9b080f4357b86f51467098da8815cc6d6c, regenerated VIXEN shaders, and a native rebuild. The generator should keep one canonical block/member lowering across body, guard, and descriptor faces.

title: Generated GPU storage writers need an automatic hand-consumer hazard seam
body: The generated-system runner did not register storage-buffer refs as ComputeStorageWrite accesses, and the hand-authored BodyInstanceRayMarch consumed TileHeader/TileSortedCandidate through plain descriptor providers. Recovery required extending GeneratedSystemStage with buffer-write gatherers plus a manual tile read gatherer and ordering edge in BuildRenderGraph.cpp. The facade should derive the generated-writer to hand-consumer hazard from the schema resource registry so each generated output does not need bespoke graph wiring.

title: Generated GPU storage-input hazards need an automatic read gatherer
body: The generated-system runner honored manifest ordering and registered generated storage writes, but it did not register generated storage-buffer inputs with BufferSyncGathererNode. GB1 scatter-to-sort therefore had topology without a shader-write-to-read memory dependency; recovery added a generic read gatherer in GeneratedSystemStage.h. The facade should derive input buffer hazard tracking from manifest access declarations.

title: Queued VIXEN builds should resolve the active WSL binary tree
body: The required queued cmake --build build invocation failed before compilation with 'Error: could not load cache' because this lane's documented WSL tree is build/wsl. Recovery required the repository-root build-wsl.sh --target VIXEN entrypoint. The facade/queue contract should select or validate the configured binary tree before admission.

title: WSL look-dev diagnostics need a declared cold pipeline warm-up
body: The required 10 s WSL look-dev diagnostic cannot reach a GPU submission on a fresh build cache: queued vixen_lookdev_capture with one midday angle timed out at 10 s during graph pipeline preparation (first run stopped at InstanceOcclusionCull; a 60 s single prewarm and 64x64 B1-off phase run stopped at test_compute_pipeline), with no device-loss line or image. I had to run extra bounded prewarm/phase diagnostics and still could not produce the requested valid image. Add a declared cache-warm/preflight phase or make the capture watchdog start after graph preparation, preserving a separate dispatch watchdog.

title: Native capture watchdog must start after runner preparation
body: The queued native look-dev command wrapped tools/vixen-native.sh with a 10s watchdog; the runner spent the entire budget in do_prepare/sync before invoking run-capture.bat, so the diagnostic had no GPU result. A direct PowerShell launch of the already-built executable was required to get a bounded native process test. The facade/runner should expose a prepare-then-capture boundary or make the watchdog apply to the capture phase.

title: Look-dev capture harness should expose its capture directory contract
body: The direct native look-dev invocation set VIXEN_LOOKDEV_OUTPUT, but the test only reads VIXEN_LOOKDEV_CAPTURE_DIR and failed before dispatch with outputEnv == NULL. Recovery required inspecting test_lookdev_capture.cpp and resubmitting with the canonical variable. Add a runner preflight or one documented helper that validates the capture-directory contract before starting the GPU process. Tier luna: this is a normal harness/diagnostic contract fix with an obvious preflight test.

title: Native correctness captures should default to shared GPU queue mode
body: The first native confirmation was submitted as --gpu-benchmark and waited for the quiet benchmark window even though this was a correctness capture, not a timing benchmark. Recovery required canceling the waiting wrapper and resubmitting the same Windows capture as resource gpu without benchmark mode. The native witness helper should classify correctness captures explicitly or provide one documented queue invocation so measurement-only quiet windows are not entered accidentally. Tier haiku: one queue classification/default with a direct admission test.
